LightningComponentBundle.description: Premium SPA component for managing personalized client messages with Cyrano AI ghostwriter capabilities.

property.name: recordId
property.label: 0. Input: Record ID
property.description: The Context ID.

property.name: inputGreetings
property.label: 1. Input: Greetings Collection
property.description: Existing greeting records.

property.name: backgroundColor
property.label: 2. Style: Background Color
property.description: Component background color.

property.name: inputIsPublished
property.label: 3. Input: Is Plan Published?
property.description: Locks the publish toggle.

property.name: rowsPerPage
property.label: 4a. Display: Visible Rows (Pagination)
property.description: How many greetings to show in the table before pagination starts.

property.name: visibleLines
property.label: 4b. Display: Visible Text Lines
property.description: How many lines of the greeting message to show before making it scrollable.

property.name: autoFitGreetingBox
property.label: 4c. Editor: Auto-fit Greeting Text Box?
property.description: If true, the editor text box dynamically grows with the content.

property.name: useModalForEditor
property.label: 4d. UI: Open Editor in Modal?
property.description: If true, the editor opens in a beautiful overlay modal instead of replacing the entire dashboard view.

property.name: editorModalWidth
property.label: 4e. UI: Editor Modal Width
property.description: Set the width of the modal (e.g., '800px', '1000px', '80%'). Only applies if 'Open Editor in Modal' is true.

property.name: inputActiveGreeting
property.label: 5. Input: Active Greeting Record
property.description: The currently active personal greeting record.

property.name: inputAiFlowApiName
property.label: 6. Setup: AI Flow API Name (Editor)
property.description: The exact API name of the Autolaunched Flow that returns the AI Ghostwriter output.

property.name: showAiSection
property.label: 8. AI: Show Dashboard AI Accordion?
property.description: Set to true to display the Formue Intelligence section on the main dashboard.

property.name: defaultAccordionOpen
property.label: 8b. AI: Default Dashboard Accordion Open?
property.description: If true, the dashboard AI panel starts expanded.

property.name: isAiLoading
property.label: 9. AI: Show Dashboard Loading Animation?
property.description: Set to true while waiting for AI generation from the Flow.

property.name: aiInsightSummary
property.label: 10. AI: Dashboard Insight HTML
property.description: The Rich Text output from the AI for the Dashboard Overview.

property.name: inputAutoOpenRecordId
property.label: [LEGACY] Input: Auto-Open Record ID
property.description: Do not use. Kept to prevent deployment errors.

property.name: outputAiPromptContext
property.label: [LEGACY] Output: AI Context
property.description: Do not use. Kept to prevent deployment errors.

property.name: aiDraftGreeting
property.label: [LEGACY] AI: Ghostwriter Draft Text
property.description: Do not use. Kept to prevent deployment errors.

property.name: outputAction
property.label: Output: Action (SAVE)
property.description: Routing action emitted on save.

property.name: outputIsPublished
property.label: Output: Is Published
property.description: State of the publish toggle.

property.name: outputGreetings
property.label: Output: Greetings (To Save)
property.description: Updated records for DML.

property.name: outputGreetingsToDelete
property.label: Output: Greetings (To DELETE)
property.description: Records flagged for deletion.
